get_word_tokenizer_moses: get a Moses word tokenizer for a given language code like eng or fra
get_word_tokenizer_nltk: get an NLTK word tokenizer by passing default nltk to get_word_tokenizer
get_word_tokenizer_thai: get a Thai word tokenizer by passing thai or tha as the language code
NLTKTokenizer_tokenize: tokenize English text into words using the NLTKTokenizer class and its tokenize method
ChineseTokenizer_tokenize: tokenize Chinese text into words using the ChineseTokenizer class and its tokenize method
